Anthracnose.quote: Brown or black lesions on leaves, panicles, and fruits. Affected nuts show shriveling and premature drop.
On the leaves and branches, they are necrotic spots that are reddish-brown when young, becoming brown and dark when the affected organs reach maturity.
water-soaked spots initially and become orange-brown to light-reddish with age and sporulation of the fungus. In severe cases leaves and fruitlets become totally blighted and drop

Red_Rust.quote: Algal leaf and stem spots (red rust) are caused by Cephaleuros virescens.
one or more red, circular powdery spots on the upper side of the leaves
